newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen up on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen up on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to gain slightly on Wednesday on new accounts day buying, but dealers said overall sentiment would remain mixed as worries about the broad economic picture continue to deter investors.
"A small technical rally is due because the market is oversold," dealer Mohammad Iqbal said.
"Sentiment will remain mixed on lack of buying interest from investors," dealer Rony Byramjee said.
On Tuesday, the Karachi 100-share index rose 1.24 points, or 0.08 percent, to end at 1,533.05. Losers led gainers 185 to 59 in a turnover of 59.47 million shares. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
